title: Virtual Compute: evt collection
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency. Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank. Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use default remittance allocation order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity. Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities. Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference. A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting. No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Evidence — confirmed payment

For payment, The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, status, external reference, method. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.
